newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble steady, unaffected as usual by Yeltsin news.
newsitem.headline: Rouble steady, unaffected as usual by Yeltsin news.

text.p: The rouble was steady in lively trading on Thursday, under the strict control of the central bank and so as usual unaffected by news about President Boris Yeltsin's health, dealers said.
roubles/dollar Jan 9 midday Jan 9 early Jan 8 close
Yeltsin was admitted to hospital on Wednesday with signs of pneumonia, which was subsequently diagnosed.
"This news used to influence the market but now all rate fluctuations are based on the (rouble/dollar) corridor," European Trade Bank dealer Yevgeny Yakubovsky said.
But dealers said more visible changes were likely if Yeltsin's condition worsened.
"If we learn that his illness is serious, T-bill prices would fall and that will eventually push down the rouble against the dollar," one dealer said.
